interpretation: Scores are on this synthetic CSV only, including authored Singlish/Sinhala trade phrases. Grouped splits hide exact stems from test, but templates remain easier than real child speech. Macro-F1 is not comparable across different intent sets. Native-speaker review of SI/Singlish is still pending. Do not treat these numbers as viva proof of classroom accuracy.
